requirements.summary: The specified outputs do not depend on the register values at power-up: unknown, all zeros, all ones or mixed.
One clock edge with rst high gives ready, out_valid, odd, count and err their reset values, also with data in flight.
STAGES-1 edges after the reset every valid bit is known and ready rises; an input offered before is refused.
Data registers have no reset. Their unknown value is visible only on out_data while out_valid is low.
The counter adds one or two for every output, as the step setting says, and wraps.
The error flag is set by a refused input, stays, and is cleared by a reset.
